carrera.cotejo.dictamen_ensayo: Supplied trial opinion. Awaiting review by the competent authority.
carrera.cotejo.huella_local: Fingerprint of local preparation material. It does not verify the rules.
carrera.cotejo.error.no_disponible: The check is unavailable. Review the producer response and the supplied versions.
carrera.cotejo.error.consulta_invalida: The query is incomplete or contains repeated references. Review the preparation data.
carrera.cotejo.error.json_invalido: The preparation could not be read. Review the file format and message catalog.
carrera.cotejo.motivo.cumple_aportado: The trial producer supplies a favourable check.
carrera.cotejo.motivo.no_cumple_aportado: The trial producer supplies a verified contradiction.
carrera.cotejo.motivo.pendiente_aportado: The trial producer leaves the requirement awaiting verification.
carrera.cotejo.guarda.texto_libre: The requirement is expressed only as text. It remains pending.
carrera.cotejo.guarda.regla_ausente: The requirement rule reference is missing. It remains pending.
carrera.cotejo.guarda.soporte_ausente: The trial lacks an accredited fact with identified evidence. It remains pending.
carrera.cotejo.pendiente.seleccion_nomin: Awaiting the Selection contract and authorised reader.
carrera.cotejo.pendiente.lector_personal: Awaiting authorised Personal and Merits readers.
carrera.cotejo.pendiente.admision: Submission and admission belong to the selection process.
carrera.cotejo.estado.cumple: Meets the requirement in the supplied opinion.
carrera.cotejo.estado.no_cumple: Does not meet the requirement in the supplied opinion.
